is up ~2% in premarket trading Tuesday after releasing topline phase 3 data showing that ulefnersen led to improvements in functional impairment and survival in individuals with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis caused by mutations in the fused in sarcoma gene (FUS-ALS).

The FUSION study also met several secondary endpoints, including significant improvements, including change from baseline in serum neurofilament light chain, and time to death, permanent ventilation, rescue, or withdrawal due to disease progression.
Ulefnersen is an RNA-targeted therapy that addresses the underlying cause of the condition.
